verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documented cold-start latency figures, sub-second or few-second, for creating or booting sandboxes. The only speed-related claim is that starting from a snapshot is 'much faster than creating from scratch', which is a relative statement about skipping dependency installation, not a documented cold-start time. That claim is adjacent at best and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start sandboxes with documented sub-second-to-few-second cold starts
